guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：安全網頁應用程式防護
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Web-application protection systems
guides.concept: 以應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「應用資產」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「信任邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「輸入格式」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正規化與解析次序可能改變檢查結果。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「規則範圍」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「False positive」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：合法變體誤攔應以業務案例重現。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Rate limiting」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「原站保護」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：入口防護需避免未受控旁路直達原站。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定流量，只改規則數量與處理成本。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「回應資料」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「檢測與封鎖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先觀察可協助調校，但不等於已阻止流量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「規則版本」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「防護驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正常、邊界與合成異常案例均需覆蓋。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「應用資產」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around application assets, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat trust boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around input formats, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Normalization/parsing order can change inspection results. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule scopes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around false positives, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reproduce benign false blocks with business cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rate limiting as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around origin protection, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ingress protection needs closure of uncontrolled origin bypasses. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix traffic and vary rule count/processing cost. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat response data as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection versus blocking, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation aids tuning but does not imply blocking. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule versions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around protection acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance covers benign, boundary and synthetic anomaly cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat application assets as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「回滾決策」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「防護驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「防護驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for rollback decisions. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for protection acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 增加拒絕率必然代表安全性提高。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Higher rejection rates necessarily mean greater security. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 企業零信任網路
related.why: 可移植「應用資產」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from application assets; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「應用資產」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from application assets; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證；「企業零信任網路」主要處理資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation; Enterprise zero-trust networks emphasizes resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「安全網頁應用程式防護」與「企業零信任網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「規則範圍」的對照方法至「裝置證據」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Web-application protection systems and Enterprise zero-trust networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from rule scopes to device evidence, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
